thesis: Private underbuilt lots where the walk-away land price (at target yield on cost, owner-builder basis) covers the comp-based land estimate. Those are the sites to make offers on. City-owned HPD/DCAS/EDC lots are a separate RFP pipeline.

counts.reprocessed_offline: 2026-10-23 — subset of the last live scan re-underwritten with engine v4; full refresh on next Actions run

program_assumptions.hard_cost_basis_note: institutional = third-party GC bid; owner_builder = principal acts as GC (Ground Up Group), ~15-18% below

rent_mo.s8_note: Voucher pays the LESSER of VPS and a rent-reasonableness comp — modeled as min(market, VPS). Benefit is 2% vacancy, not a premium.

program_assumptions.note: Screening estimates, not appraisals. Costs on gross area; owner-builder basis assumes the principal is the GC. Program terms per HPD 485-x page and City of Yes UAP (verified Oct 2026).

assumptions.land_blend: 60% real vacant-land sale comps ($/SF by borough, last 18mo) + 40% assessed x2
assumptions.actionable: offer = walk-away >= est. land (bid at/under comps); negotiate = walk-away 70-100% of est. land (needs a motivated seller); program = only the HPD subsidy stack works; rfp = city-owned disposition; pass = dropped.
assumptions.occupied_rule: Lots with 3+ existing residential units are tenanted teardowns (relocation, 485-x replacement units) — demoted and flagged; 10+ units excluded.
assumptions.owner_classes: private -> outreach; institutional (church, yeshiva, hospital, university, HDFC) -> outreach, but the sale needs a board vote plus Attorney General or court approval under N-PCL 511 (6-12 months); HPD/DCAS/EDC -> RFP pipeline; other agencies (Parks, DOT, DEP, DOE, NYCHA, Sanitation, NYPD, FDNY, Transit, Cultural Affairs, libraries, courts, state, federal) -> excluded as not acquirable.
assumptions.neighborhood_rent: Market rents are borough baseline x a published ZIP factor (LIC 1.5x, Williamsburg 1.35x, East NY 0.8x, etc.); unlisted ZIPs = 1.0.
assumptions.acris_motivated: Motivated-seller flag from real ACRIS records: owner tenure = years since the latest recorded deed (25y+ = long-hold/estate, low basis); free-and-clear = no mortgage recorded after that deed. Motivated = 25y+ tenure OR (free-and-clear AND 15y+). Owner mailing = grantee address on the current deed.
assumptions.note: Screening estimates for outreach, not appraisals. Every number derived from public data + these published assumptions.
